cohort: 407 women with Type 1 (n=185) or Type 2 (n=212) pregestational diabetes who intended exclusive or partial breastfeeding and delivered at ≥34 weeks of gestation
finding: While women with Type 1 diabetes had higher intentions to breastfeed exclusively, they ultimately had higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding and breastfeeding initiation at discharge compared to women with Type 2 diabetes.
mod_finding: Women with Type 1 diabetes were more likely to deliver by primary cesarean section compared to women with Type 2 diabetes (37% vs 26%).
